name: sysctl-insecure
description: Practice-box misconfiguration: installs an /etc/sysctl.d drop-in with insecure kernel/network values (ip_forward=1, randomize_va_space=0, rp_filter=0, accept_redirects=1) and applies them. Paired checks read the live sysctl values. No vars.
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
f=/etc/sysctl.d/99-relay-insecure.conf
cat > "$f" <<'EOF'
net.ipv4.ip_forward = 1
kernel.randomize_va_space = 0
net.ipv4.conf.all.rp_filter = 0
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 1
EOF
sysctl --system >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
